actions: Open normal paid CBT URL with no dev parameter.
Complete Speaking with normal controls, synthetic QA microphone input, and accelerated timers only.
Continue to Listening and answer all 30 questions through normal auto-advance.
Traverse all 31 Reading questions and verify answer persistence with real Previous/Next controls.
Type both Writing answers and finish with the real confirmation modal.
Exercise all four result tabs, Listening direct replay/return, and Set 01 restart.
